ctx.x: Benny Benack, there’s a guy named Tony Glausi, these are three trumpet players that are on it. Their social media presence is strong, they post almost every day or every other day with something. It’s informative and they’re great musicians and they’re good people. And I suggest to people to follow those kind of examples of what it’s going to feel like, be like and look like in the future.
All right. Do you have any feeling about why in 2020, or this time in our history, that this pandemic occurred?
